resources.string:
Unfret looks at a shop page, an ad or a service provider's page and tells you in plain words whether it all adds up.

• Share a link to Unfret from any app, or paste it here. The page opens inside Unfret, on your phone, over your own connection, so you can accept a cookie banner or solve a captcha.

• Nothing is read until you tap Check this page. Then Unfret reads the page on your phone: the product facts and the visible text. Account menus, greetings, forms, checkout and delivery areas, and any address that isn't the business's own are removed first. On a private seller's ad, the seller's name is never read.

• Only those facts, that text and the page address are sent, to unfret.net, with your Unfret pass. Nothing about you or your phone.

• Once you agree, Unfret makes its own pass on this phone, with free deep checks: no code, no account. Each deep check uses one; after them, quick checks stay free, and a gift code from a friend adds deep checks.

• The app keeps only your pass on the phone, encrypted. Android's backup keeps one yes or no, in your own Google backup: that this phone already got its free checks. Never your pass. Pages you open aren't kept: their cookies and cache are deleted when you close them.
This phone has had its free checks. Get a new pass for free quick checks, or paste the pass you have.
Quick checks stay free; a gift code from a friend adds deep checks.
A gift code goes onto the Unfret pass on this phone.
This takes a few seconds. Unfret makes its own Unfret pass on this phone: no code, no account.

No code, no account. Before you pay on a marketplace or a web shop, for a second-hand ad, or to a tradesperson or local service, share the page to Unfret and it tells you in plain words whether it all adds up.
After your free checks, quick checks stay free: they read the page itself, by its rules. Deep checks also look the shop up elsewhere.
This phone has had its free checks already, so your new Unfret pass starts without them. Quick checks stay free; for deep checks, use a gift code from a friend.
There were no free checks to give just now, so your new Unfret pass starts without them. Quick checks stay free; for deep checks, use a gift code from a friend.
